plainTranslation:
This person can push you further than you should go. The chemistry here is energizing, but it can also make bad ideas sound brilliant. They may encourage you to take bigger risks, move faster, or commit before you have thought things through. Around them, caution can start to feel boring, and that is exactly where the trouble starts.

They help you stop playing small. They challenge excuses, call out fear, and push you to take chances you might otherwise avoid. Sometimes that is exactly what you need.

The problem is that neither of you may know when to slow down. Confidence can become overconfidence. Encouragement can start to feel like pressure. You can get so caught up in the momentum that neither of you stops to check whether the risk is worth it. The excitement is real. So are the consequences.

This connection can help you step outside your comfort zone and trust yourself more. It encourages growth through action, reminding you that confidence is built by taking meaningful steps forward. Be willing to take the chance when it aligns with your goals and values. Just remember that enthusiasm is most powerful when it is paired with preparation and intention.
